issues.detail: The Greek 'οὐκ ἀν ἐτεθνηκεὶ' is a conditional construction (οὐκ + αν) expressing 'would not have died' (counterfactual). The Vietnamese translation 'không chết' translates this as a simple present/future negative 'do not die', missing the counterfactual/past-conditional nuance of the Greek.
